magmuth.title: The Obsidian Islands
magmuth.alt: Black volcanic-glass islands break a glowing lava sea beneath banks of ash and crimson smoke.
magmuth.caption: Magmuth's transient islands cool from lava, then disappear as eruptions renew the crust.

magmuth.title: The Fissure Forges
magmuth.alt: Ash-covered gantries and extraction pipes span a basalt fissure glowing with magma.
magmuth.caption: The old forges draw on Magmuth's fissures and fuel-bearing gases.

poseidas.title: The storm ocean
poseidas.alt: Blue storm swells engulf a tiny pale island; distant hydro-processing structures stand beneath a vast cyclone.
poseidas.caption: Little dry ground remains above Poseidas's storm-racked global ocean.

poseidas.title: The deep cities
poseidas.alt: Illuminated underwater structures and algae-processing rigs follow a submerged ridge into blue depths.
poseidas.caption: Poseidas's cities moved deeper to escape the surface storms and death tides.

grimedes.title: The lightless undergrowth
grimedes.alt: Pitch-black stalks and broad wet leaves cover a flat, foggy plain beneath a faint red horizon.
grimedes.caption: Grimedes's vegetation gathers the scarce light of its dying brown dwarf.

grimedes.title: Black-site observatories
grimedes.alt: A weathered telescope dish and low research buildings stand among black vegetation and mist.
grimedes.caption: The observatories on Grimedes were built to study the black hole and the space beyond Xalia.

luminax.title: The prismatic solarscape
luminax.alt: Pale crystalline vegetation and immense silver solar grids surround scorched ground under twin suns.
luminax.caption: Luminax's sunward face holds prismatic oases, solar farms and the scars of ION-9.

luminax.title: At the edge of the blast zone
luminax.alt: Translucent leaves scatter rainbow light beside blackened soil and damaged solar panels.
luminax.caption: Crystalline leaves filter the relentless light; ION-9's misfires scar the land around them.

floria.title: The World Trees
floria.alt: Immense tree crowns rise through clouds, joined by road-sized branches and enormous leaves.
floria.caption: The World Trees absorbed Floria's oceans and sheltered its forests from the old annual deluge.

floria.title: The underforests
floria.alt: Giant buttress roots arch over a shadowed marsh filled with fungi and dense undergrowth.
floria.caption: Below the canopy, Floria's roots, wetlands and fungal thickets support an untamed ecosystem.

zolton.title: The lightning canyons
zolton.alt: Metallic mountain spires channel branching lightning into cold, gas-filled canyons.
zolton.caption: Zolton's metallic peaks conduct its storms into fleeting rivers of electricity.

zolton.title: Bloodstorm manufactory
zolton.alt: Industrial collectors stand on a frozen ridge beneath fine crimson lightning-sprite filaments.
zolton.caption: Bloodstorm sprites made the manufacture of Quantum Entanglement Devices possible.

phantiri.title: The Dreadscape
phantiri.alt: Fog veils dark coastal cliffs of compressed fossil-rich strata above still, tar-like basins.
phantiri.caption: Centuries of the Generator's failed attempts at organic life reshaped Phantiri's surface.

phantiri.title: A Dreadscape basin
phantiri.alt: A still black inlet lies between layered banks of fragmented organic remains and windless fog.
phantiri.caption: The Dreadscape's compressed remains drain into dark basins beneath the persistent fog.

stonera.title: The Chasm
stonera.alt: A vast terraced planetary wound descends to a silvery sea beneath suspended rocky ejecta.
stonera.caption: The Terracannon exposed Stonera's liquid-metal ocean; a strip-mine now spirals into the Chasm.

stonera.title: The Jorian impact fields
stonera.alt: Dusty grey craters, fractured ridges and a mine entrance lie beneath static discharges and meteor trails.
stonera.caption: The Jorian Belt repeatedly bombards Stonera, leaving valuable minerals and unstable ground.

drainov.title: The acid swamps
drainov.alt: Corroded factories and pipeways sink into steaming green-brown wetlands beneath poisonous smog.
drainov.caption: Drainov's ruined industry subsides into acid swamps as refuse continues to fall from orbit.

drainov.title: Carbide-1
drainov.alt: Ruptured tanks and sagging feedstock pipes vent green-grey fumes over corroded refinery walkways.
drainov.caption: The Carbide-1 catastrophe poisoned a world; abandoned automated plants continued the destruction.

saiphus.title: The floating archipelago
saiphus.alt: Grassy islands and a distant city float above layers of rose-lit clouds and darker storms.
saiphus.caption: Saiphus's buoyant islands occupy a narrow habitable band above its crushing depths.

saiphus.title: The Benthane refineries
saiphus.alt: Gas compression tanks and pipework occupy a grassy floating island above a rose-lit cloud abyss.
saiphus.caption: Saiphus's compression plants refine Benthane into coolants vital to interstellar travel.

telypso.title: The fungal forests
telypso.alt: Towering iridescent mushrooms and pitcher plants surround a shimmering river in fluorescent mist.
telypso.caption: Telypso's forests shift and pulse with the psychic state of the world around them.

telypso.title: The quicksilver rivers
telypso.alt: Iridescent river water rises in suspended bubbles beside glasslike plants and alien fungi.
telypso.caption: On Telypso, even flowing water and falling rain need not obey familiar physics.

krystos.title: The frozen estates
krystos.alt: Ruined ornamental estates emerge from windblown snow beside a frozen ocean and distant ice peaks.
krystos.caption: The Thousand Families' island retreats lie frozen beneath Krystos's enduring impact winter.

krystos.title: The techno-catacombs
krystos.alt: Frosted computing cabinets and dense cable bundles recede through a cold mountain tunnel.
krystos.caption: APEX used Krystos's cold to house the computing infrastructure that produced the Nemesis Plague.

veridium.title: The factory world
veridium.alt: Factory trenches and furnace districts spread beyond silver vegetation and liquid-metal channels.
veridium.caption: Veridium's vast industrial landscape is quieter now, with only part of its old capacity in use.

veridium.title: The drone scrapfields
veridium.alt: Ancient broken machines and a partly dismantled starship lie beneath distant shipyard cranes.
veridium.caption: Old robotic wreckage and the ships lost in the End Wars feed Veridium's salvage economy.

endessa.title: The glass dunes
endessa.alt: Sweeping glass-sand dunes reveal dark substrate and buried structures beneath two suns.
endessa.caption: Endessa's desert formed from the shattered glass of its bombarded ocean floor.

endessa.title: The Nightcap wells
endessa.alt: Drilling rigs and pipes descend through a dry cavern to pools of thick green-black oil.
endessa.caption: Beneath the dunes, the Nightcap wells still supply the stasis oil used for sub-light travel.
